title: 30 metrgacha yetadigan, dinozavrdan og'ir bu hayvon qaysi?
hook: Bu hayvon har qanday dinozavrdan og'irroq.

scenes.text: Bu hayvon fanga ma'lum har qanday dinozavrdan ham og'irroq.
Uzunligi 30 metrgacha yetadi, bu ketma-ket qo'yilgan ikkita shahar avtobusidan ham uzun.
Lekin u quruqlikda emas, okeanda yashaydi va havo bilan nafas oladi.
Bu ko'k kit, fanga ma'lum eng katta hayvon.
Shunday ulkan jonzot esa asosan bir necha santimetrlik mayda kril bilan oziqlanadi.

description:
Ko'k kitning uzunligi 30 metrgacha yetadi va u fanga ma'lum eng katta hayvon hisoblanadi. U asosan bir necha santimetrlik mayda kril bilan oziqlanadi.

Siz buni bilarmidingiz? Izohda "ha" yoki "yo'q" deb yozing.
source: Fact-check 2026-11-09: MISLEADING title fixed ('30 metrlik' implied every blue whale is 30 m; typical adults are shorter, the maximum is about 30 m, so the title now says 'gacha'). Heavier than any dinosaur: TRUE (blue whale roughly 100-190 t versus largest sauropods roughly 60-90 t by most estimates), https://www.popsci.com/?p=770195 and https://www.discoverwildlife.com/animal-facts/marine-animals/biggest-marine-animals ; length: up to about 30 m (largest reports about 33-34 m, https://livescience.com/64459-blue-whale.html), Britannica, https://www.britannica.com/animal/blue-whale ; diet almost entirely krill, NOAA Fisheries, https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/species/blue-whale (page could not be opened in this session, claim confirmed via Live Science and Britannica). Caveat kept in script: only 'heavier', never 'longer', because the longest sauropods may match or exceed a blue whale in length.
